# @tiavision/sinter-alloy

> Opinionated sinter components that need a script: `<alloy-sortable>` (reorder a list), `<alloy-board>` (cards within and between columns) (each reports a drop as `move`; the page saves it with an action on the component's tag); `<alloy-split>` (two panes); `<alloy-date>`, `<alloy-range>`, `<alloy-month>` (pickers in the page's language); `<alloy-palette>` (Ctrl+K); `<alloy-virtual>` (a long list over sinter's append pagination). Pointer and keyboard throughout. Built for temper (a required peer). Design of the rest (boards, pickers, command palette, long lists, split panes): docs/DESIGN.md.

Setup: `sinter({ libraries: ['@tiavision/sinter-alloy'] })`; `export * as alloy from '@tiavision/sinter-alloy'` in src/sinter.helpers.ts; `export type { Move, SortableText } from '@tiavision/sinter-alloy'` in src/sinter.types.ts; with temper's plugin add `node_modules/@tiavision/sinter-alloy/sinter/components` to `paths` (icons).

- `<alloy-sortable data-sn-with="{ items: tasks, keyOf: (t) => t.id, nameOf?: (t) => t.title, label, disabled?, quiet?, text? }" data-sn-put="/api/tasks/order" data-sn-trigger="move" data-sn-body="{ order: alloy.keysAfter(tasks, $event.detail, (t) => t.id) }" data-sn-optimistic="merge(tasks.find((t) => t.id === $event.detail.key), { rank: alloy.between(tasks, $event.detail, 'rank') })" data-sn-catch="failed = true">` with a fill `<x slot="item">` reading `$slot.item`, `$slot.index` (typed `any`: cast in a let, `data-sn-let="{ f: /** @type {Folder} */ ($slot.item) }"`). The component changes nothing itself: a drop emits `move` = `Move { key, from, to, after, before, via: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }`, and the page saves it, in any API shape (sinter 0.23: `$event` in `data-sn-optimistic`). The resource has `order="<field>"`, so the optimistic merge sorts the row into place; sinter queues the saves of quick moves (`data-sn-concurrency` `queue`) and rolls a refused one back: the page shows its own note (an alert under a `data-sn-if`). The server's renumbered answer is written through with an OpenAPI spec; without one, `data-sn-then="refresh(tasks)"`.
- Items from state: `data-sn-on-move="names = alloy.reorder(names, $event.detail)"`. An API that takes one item and its neighbour: `data-sn-body="{ id: $event.detail.key, after: $event.detail.after }"`.
- `<alloy-board data-sn-with="{ lists, listKey: (l) => l.id, listName?: (l) => l.title, items: cards, keyOf: (c) => c.id, nameOf?, group: 'status', label, disabled?, text? }">` with fills `slot="item"` ($slot.item, $slot.index, $slot.list) and `slot="list"` ($slot.list, $slot.count): a card's `group` field names its column. `move` is a BoardMove (Move + fromGroup, toGroup), saved as the sortable's: `data-sn-put="/api/cards/order" data-sn-trigger="move" data-sn-body="{ group: $event.detail.toGroup, order: alloy.columnAfter(cards, $event.detail, (c) => c.id, 'status') }" data-sn-optimistic="merge(cards.find((c) => c.id === $event.detail.key), { status: $event.detail.toGroup, rank: alloy.rankIn(cards, $event.detail, (c) => c.id, 'status', 'rank') })"`; cards in state: `cards = alloy.regroup(cards, $event.detail, (c) => c.id, 'status')`. Keys as the sortable's plus ArrowLeft/ArrowRight between columns.
- `<alloy-split data-sn-with="{ name?, initial, min, max, step?, label, controls?, direction?: 'row' | 'column', reverse? }">` with `<x slot="start">` and `<x slot="end">`: lays them out (a grid filling its box: give a column split a height), keeps the size in localStorage under `sn:alloy-split:<name>`; or `data-sn-model="state.width"` (value/change). Keys: arrows (Shift ×4), Home/End, Enter collapses/opens; double-click resets to initial. CSP: the first frame's size is a style attribute: `style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'`, else 30% until the module runs.
- `<alloy-date data-sn-model="d" data-sn-with="{ label, min?, max?, marks?, required?, placeholder?, text? }">`: ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`; shows `date(value, 'medium')`, reads typed dates in the page language's order; calendar popover. `<alloy-range data-sn-with="{ params?: ['start', 'end'], start, end, label, min?, max?, marks? }">`: with params writes the URL through navigate(); else handle `change` ({ start, end }, cancelable). `<alloy-month data-sn-model="m">`: `YYYY-MM`. Language: $locale, else the page's lang. Keys: arrows, PageUp/PageDown (Shift: year), Home/End, Enter, Escape; Alt+ArrowDown opens the date's.
- `<alloy-palette data-sn-with="{ label, src?, commands?: PaletteCommand[], keys?: false }">`: Ctrl/⌘+K; lists `nav a[href]` and buttons with `data-shortcut`/`aria-keyshortcuts`, plus `commands`, plus `GET <src>?q=` → `[{ id, label, href?, group?, keywords?, shortcut? }]`; picking follows href (navigate), clicks the button, or emits `pick`.
- `<alloy-virtual data-sn-with="{ items, keyOf, label, total?, estimate?, overscan? }" data-sn-on-end="page(list, 'next')">` with `<x slot="item">` ($slot.item, $slot.index): renders the rows in view; the list is a resource with `paginate="{ append: { after: $item.id }, size: 100 }"`; give it a height. temper's `data-tm-lazy` first.
- Helpers: `reorder(list, move)`, `keysAfter(list, move, keyOf)`, `between(list, move, field)` (midpoint of the new neighbours' values, ±1 at the ends; equal neighbours: their value), `moved(list, move, keyOf)`; boards: `columnAfter(list, move, keyOf, group)`, `rankIn(list, move, keyOf, group, field)`, `regroup(list, move, keyOf, group)`.
- Keys: Space/Enter on the handle lifts, ArrowUp/Down/Home/End move, Space/Enter drops, Escape or Tab away cancels; announced in a live region; `text` (SortableText: handle(name), instructions, lifted/moved/dropped(name, position, total), cancelled(name, position)) for other languages.
- Tests: `render()` with the component's HTML as a component and its script in `scripts`; a script's state writes render on the next task (`await settle()`, or a `setTimeout(0)` then `flush()` while a request is held).
